articles.summary: BETHESDA, Md., Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Eagle Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: EGBN), the Bethesda-based holding company for EagleBank, one of the largest community banks in the Washington, D.C. region, announced today that Ces Escamilla has joined EagleBank as 1 st Senior Vice President, Senior Director of Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Strategic Growth. In this newly created role, Escamilla will lead efforts to expand EagleBank's CRE lending capabilities by helping architect, launch and scale new lines of business and specialized financing solutions. He will also focus on identifying and advancing strategic growth opportunities that broaden the bank’s capabilities, enhance client solutions, and support the continued evolution of EagleBank’s commercial real estate platform. articles.title: Veteran Commercial Real Estate Banker Cesar “Ces” Escamilla Joins EagleBank to Accelerate Growth

articles.summary: BETHESDA, Md., Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Eagle Bancorp, Inc . (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: EGBN), the Bethesda-based holding company for EagleBank, one of the largest community banks in the Washington D.C. area, today announced that it will host a teleconference call for the financial community on October 22, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. (EDT). On this call, Eagle Bancorp Inc.’s Chief Executive Officer Steve Curley and Chief Financial Officer Eric Newell will discuss earnings for the third quarter 2026 financial results. Those results will be released after the close of business on October 21, 2026. Interested parties will need to register at the below-noted URL in order to listen and participate in the call. Once a participant registers with a valid email, they will receive a dial-in phone number and unique PIN number which will be needed to access the call.
